The tallest is Bodian Massa at 208 cm. The youngest is Marc-Owen Fodzo Dada (born 2006) and the most experienced David Lighty (born 1988). Beyond France, the squad draws most on USA (7), Australia (1) and Ukraine (1). David Lighty, Edwin Jackson and Yves Pons are back for another spell at the club.
